steps.action: Authenticate on the operations sign-in surface and open the authenticated retry fixture URL
steps.expected: A live authenticated delivery log with deterministic retryable rows is visible
steps.observed: Login succeeded and /email-delivery?fixture=retry-actions rendered retry buttons for failed and bounced rows on current HEAD fdc4edaf.

steps.action: Click the failed-row Retry button to open the confirmation dialog
steps.expected: A confirmation modal appears before the resend action is dispatched
steps.observed: The modal opened with visible Cancel and Confirm Retry actions after selecting the failed fixture row retry button.

steps.action: Confirm the retry and wait for the request to settle
steps.expected: A success toast is shown and the delivery log refetches to the fixture-backed GET endpoint
steps.observed: After confirming, the page showed a toast close button, network capture recorded POST /api/ops/email-delivery/retry followed by GET /api/ops/email-delivery?...&fixture=retry-actions, and the UI remained on the delivery log surface with retry controls restored after refetch.

evidence.network: network-after-confirm.txt recorded POST http://app.localhost:3000/api/ops/email-delivery/retry followed by GET http://app.localhost:3000/api/ops/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&range=7d&page=1&pageSize=50&fixture=retry-actions
evidence.domEvidence: Annotated post-confirm screenshot showed the toast close affordance and retry controls re-rendered; the follow-up GET proves the delivery log refetched immediately after successful retry confirmation.

frictions.description: agent-browser text extraction returned minimal output for the success toast body, so confirmation relied on annotated screenshot state plus captured request sequence.
frictions.resolution: Captured before/dialog/after annotated screenshots and network request log around the confirm action to verify both success feedback presence and immediate refetch.

summary: Fresh authenticated rerun for VAL-ACT-004 passed on current HEAD fdc4edaf. The failed fixture row opened the retry dialog, Confirm Retry issued the live retry POST, and the surface immediately refetched the fixture-backed delivery log while showing success feedback UI.
